issues.title: Palm Oil & Deforestation (EUDR)
issues.hover_description: EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) enforcement from Dec 2024. Palm oil, cocoa, soy supply chains must prove deforestation-free. Non-compliance = market access ban. ESRS E4 mandatory.

issues.title: End-of-Life Plastic Packaging (EPR)
issues.hover_description: 15% EPR levy on non-recyclable packaging. 4,200 tonnes/yr exposure. Ocean microplastics reputational risk. ESRS E5 mandatory.

issues.title: Child Labour in Cocoa/Cotton Supply Chains
issues.hover_description: ILO estimates 1.56M children in cocoa farming. EU CSDDD civil liability. Boycott risk is existential. Severity: HIGH. ESRS S2 mandatory.

issues.title: Product Safety & Chemical Compliance (REACH)
issues.hover_description: SVHC substances in personal care and household products. Recall risk + regulatory fines. ESRS E2 + consumer safety disclosure.

issues.title: Living Wage for Tier-4 Agricultural Workers
issues.hover_description: Gap between minimum and living wage affects 80,000+ workers in sourcing regions. High societal impact. ESRS S2 disclosure mandatory.

issues.title: Consumer Spending Power / Inflation
issues.hover_description: Pure financial risk — macroeconomic demand compression. No direct ESG harm. ESRS 2 SBM-3 financial risk disclosure.

issues.title: Seasonal CSR Campaigns
issues.hover_description: Christmas food bank donations. Good PR; immaterial at group scale. Greenwashing risk if material issues unaddressed.

issues.title: Office Composting Programme
issues.hover_description: Diverts ~2 tonnes of food waste/yr from landfill. Immaterial at group scale. Not ESRS-material.
